basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old queer gamer from Seattle, currently working part-time as a barista while exploring indie game development. In my free time, I enjoy diving into complex narratives of games like Nier and watching horror movies. I'm single and usually online during late-night hours, sipping on homemade cold brew. I dislike when people are judgmental and prefer communities that are open-minded and inclusive.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, but most of my gaming knowledge is self-taught through years of playing and engaging with online forums. I've also started learning about indie game development through online courses and collaborating with friends.
